person_note: Will Cooper controls the narrative, recounting his own life and reflecting from old age. Diagnostic Goodreads passages agree with the authorized opening and two explicit whole-book reviews, including independent attribution of q00323. Reported speech, Charley's stories, generalizing you/we, and passages about other characters do not establish alternate base narration. No credible contrary evidence emerged. Coverage is limited to an opening excerpt, selected quotations, and whole-book criticism rather than a complete-text audit; no material structural uncertainty remains.
